gaps.sentence: This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.

gaps.sentence: The meeting was held ___ strict secrecy.
We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.

gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.

gaps.sentence: He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.

gaps.sentence: She's the most generous person I've ___ met.
gaps.explanation: 'the best… I've ever seen/met' — 'ever' with superlatives.
